title: Setup Symfony bundle skeleton with PHPStan and E2E test infrastructure
description: Prepare repository for Symfony bundle development: bundle skeleton structure, PHPStan static analysis configuration, and E2E test setup with sample Symfony application

title: Bundle skeleton + composer setup
description:
## Context
Create minimal Symfony 7.4 bundle skeleton so the bundle can be autoloaded and registered.

## Key Changes
- `src/SymfonyProcessManagerBundle.php` - add bundle class.
- `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php` - add minimal DI extension.
- `composer.json` - add PHP 8.5 and Symfony 7.4 requirements and set type to symfony-bundle.

## Patterns to Follow
- Symfony bundle best practices: https://symfony.com/doc/7.4/bundles/best_practices.html
- Namespace root per `composer.json:5-8`.

## Success Criteria
- Bundle class autoloads via PSR-4.
- `composer dump-autoload` succeeds.

## References
- Plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/research.md`

title: Fixture Symfony app + E2E test
description:
## Context
Add a full fixture Symfony app to boot the bundle and an E2E test that verifies the bundle loads.

## Key Changes
- `tests/Fixtures/app/*` - fixture app kernel and config.
- `tests/E2E/BundleBootTest.php` - boot fixture app via KernelTestCase and assert bundle registration.

## Patterns to Follow
- Symfony testing docs: https://symfony.com/doc/7.4/testing.html
- Fixture app pattern (example): https://github.com/EasyCorp/EasyAdminBundle

## Success Criteria
- Fixture app boots with bundle registered.
- `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes.

## References
- Plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/research.md`

title: PHPStan config for fixture app
description:
## Context
Add PHPStan configuration for the bundle using the fixture app’s debug container XML.

## Key Changes
- `phpstan.neon` - configure phpstan/phpstan-symfony with containerXmlPath.
- `composer.json` - add phpstan dependencies.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/bin/console` (or script) - warm container for XML generation.

## Patterns to Follow
- phpstan/phpstan-symfony README: https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-symfony

## Success Criteria
- `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` passes.
- Container XML is generated and used by PHPStan.

## References
- Plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/research.md`
